title: Interfaces for a library
description:
Declare the types and write three functions:

```typescript
interface Book { isbn: string; title: string; author: string; year: number; tags?: string[] }
interface Loan { isbn: string; member: string; due: string }   // due is "YYYY-MM-DD"

function addBook(books: readonly Book[], book: Book): Book[]
function byAuthor(books: readonly Book[]): Record<string, string[]>
function overdue(loans: readonly Loan[], books: readonly Book[], today: string): string[]
```

- `addBook` returns a **new** array with the book added, or throws an `Error` `duplicate isbn <isbn>` when a book with that isbn is already there. The input array is not changed.
- `byAuthor` maps each author to their titles sorted by year (then by title).
- `overdue` returns lines `"<member>: <title> (due <due>)"` for loans whose `due` is before `today`, sorted by due date and then member. Dates in `YYYY-MM-DD` form compare correctly as strings. A loan whose isbn matches no book uses `unknown book` as the title.
hints: `readonly Book[]` has no `push`: build the new array with `[...books, book]`.
A `Map` from isbn to title makes each loan's lookup quick; `?? "unknown book"` covers loans without a book.
